title: O God of Our Salvation

questions.question: Praise is due to you, O God, in where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 65:1 (ESV): "Praise is due to you, O God, in Zion,"

questions.question: O you who hear prayer, to you shall all flesh what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 65:2 (ESV): "O you who hear prayer, to you shall all flesh come."

questions.question: When iniquities prevail against me, you atone for our what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 65:3 (ESV): "When iniquities prevail against me, you atone for our transgressions."

questions.question: Blessed is the one you choose and bring near, to dwell in your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 65:4 (ESV): "Blessed is the one you choose and bring near, to dwell in your courts!"

questions.question: We shall be satisfied with the goodness of your house, the holiness of your what?
By awesome deeds you answer us with righteousness, O God of our what?
You visit the earth and water it; you greatly enrich it; the river of God is full of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 65:9 (ESV): "...the river of God is full of water;"

questions.question: You water its furrows abundantly, settling its ridges, softening it with what?
You crown the year with your bounty; your wagon tracks overflow with what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 65:11 (ESV): "your wagon tracks overflow with abundance." (Or fatness)

questions.question: The pastures of the wilderness overflow, the hills gird themselves with what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 65:12 (ESV): "...the hills gird themselves with joy,"

questions.question: The meadows clothe themselves with flocks, the valleys deck themselves with what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 65:13 (ESV): "...the valleys deck themselves with grain,"

questions.question: They shout and sing together for what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 65:13 (ESV): "they shout and sing together for joy."

questions.question: You who establish the mountains by your strength, being robed with what?
You silence the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, the tumult of the what?
You make the going out of the morning and the evening to shout for what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 65:8 (ESV): "you make the going out of the morning and the evening to shout for joy."

key_verse_text: Blessed is the one you choose and bring near, to dwell in your courts! We shall be satisfied with the goodness of your house, the holiness of your temple!
